adjudication.resolution: Root inspected the strict union, whole inventory/generation binding, non-null required branches, all-entry observed-zero checks and mode-specific executable validation. Current targeted regressions and actual two-entry adoption/degradation cover these changed paths.

adjudication.question: Per-entry auth/admission caller changed
adjudication.resolution: Root read current runHoopaGuard, serveEntry and controller auth prefix. Each entry keeps its own validated auth store, owner.Admit occurs before the unchanged authenticated HandleHoopaConn, missing owner/proof moves shared state to degraded, and controller authorization precedes schema branches. Actual two-entry success and missing-proof/refusal coverage plus unchanged auth implementations are adequate for the limited engineering-entry decision; not a newly run unauthorized-credential matrix.

adjudication.question: Deployment, privilege and durability expansion
adjudication.resolution: Rejected. Isolated trusted-root evidence does not authorize default privileged deployment or establish arbitrary production support. Source/receiver/SQL guarantees remain separate; basic management remains DB/GOST/TUI independent.

models.management: External core survives control frontend; explicit control-only is observe-only, recovery remains explicit and identity-checked. Production process backend must not copy root guest guards into default installation.
models.identity: boot/PID/start, executable hash/path, private nonce/intent/workdir and same-connected-controller owner proof; PID or port alone is insufficient.
models.compile: Complete immutable bundle with all referenced assets, stable provider-scoped nodes/groups, ordered rules; unsupported capabilities rejected before mutation.
models.entry: Explicit committed profile entries, no per-launch implicit reload; no missing-target/direct/provider fallback.
models.publication: Durable operation before runtime effects; verified publishing then active then terminal. Recovery reobserves owned processes; failed complete rollback produces degraded.
models.telemetry: Experimental same-data-plane source only under verified capability; stock/compatibility do not acquire this capability by proxy.
